label: Initial application creation service
instruction: Generate the initial ELM submission service using the existing models. Exactly one function submit_application(actor, data) in services/applications.py, maximum 45 lines. data is serializer validated data with leave_type, start_date, end_date, purpose. Enforce the existing application.create permission via actor.has_permission, set user_id from Principal and record submission history/task using existing fields. Use transaction.atomic. Use the existing core.api.exceptions error interfaces. Do not redefine models or generate other operations. This is initial code generation, not correction of business logic.
